textos.Convierte la voz en texto dentro de tu c: Turns speech into text on your computer. Downloaded only once.
textos.Corta escucha tu video y escribe cada pa: Corta listens to your video and writes down every word with its timing.
Corta checks on its own every 6 hours.
textos.Corta usa la IA que ya tienes, con tu cu: Corta uses the AI you already have, with your own account. We'll test it with a short question.
textos.Editas el texto: lo que borras, se borra: You edit the text: whatever you delete is cut from the video.
textos.Ej.: corta desde «te muestro» hasta «cóm: E.g.: cut from “let me show you” to “how” and zoom in on “publish”
textos.Este video es corto: funciona mejor con: This video is short: it works best with videos over a minute and a half (a class, a podcast, a live stream).
textos.Este video todavía no tiene texto. Trans: This video has no text yet. Transcribe it to edit by words and add captions.
textos.Formato {l}, 1080 px, con subtítulos. Es: {l} format, 1080 px, with captions. This happens on your computer.
textos.Hechos con la transcripción, palabra por: Made from the transcript, word by word.
textos.La transcripción se hace en tu computado: Transcription happens on your computer. A 10-minute video takes a couple of minutes.
textos.Listo: el video quedó **{s} s** más cort: Done: the video is now **{s} s** shorter.
textos.MP4, MOV o WebM. También puedes arrastra: MP4, MOV or WebM. You can also drag it here.
Lower or closer to the center.
textos.Pon un título grande al inicio: Add a big title at the start
textos.Pon zoom cuando digo algo importante: Zoom in when I say something important
textos.Queda un video de **{d}** en formato {l}: You'll get a **{d}** video in {l} format, ready to upload.
textos.Saca la parte donde me equivoco: Cut the part where I mess up
textos.Saca las pausas largas y los «eh», «mmm»: Removes long pauses and the “uh”s and “um”s in one go.
Click a word to jump to that moment. Select several (click the first, then the last with Shift) and press Delete to cut them from the video.
textos.Todo se procesa en tu computador. La IA: Everything is processed on your computer. The AI uses your own account.
textos.Trae un video y Corta lo transcribe en t: Bring a video and Corta transcribes it on your computer. Then you remove silences and filler words, pick captions and export it vertical for Shorts, Reels or TikTok.
textos.Tu IA corta, pone zooms y busca los mejo: Your AI cuts, adds zooms and finds the best moments for Shorts.
textos.Tu video vertical de **{d}** quedó guard: Your **{d}** vertical video was saved in the project folder.
Your videos never leave your computer.
textos.Un editor para Shorts, Reels y TikTok qu: An editor for Shorts, Reels and TikTok that runs on your computer. It transcribes everything, you edit the text and your own AI does the heavy lifting. Free, no watermark.
textos.{ia} está buscando los mejores momentos…: {ia} is looking for the best moments…
textos.{ia} lee la transcripción y elige los mo: {ia} reads the transcript and picks 20–60 second moments that make sense on their own and hook from the start. Each becomes a new vertical video with captions.
textos.{ia} usa tu cuenta y solo ve el texto co: {ia} uses your account and only sees the text with its timing, never the video. You can undo every change.
textos.¿Quieres otro estilo? Los estilos son ar: Want another style? Styles are simple files anyone can create and share with the community.
textos.En la app, aquí eliges un video de tu co: In the app, you pick a video from your computer here
textos.En la app, aquí se transcribe el video: In the app, the video gets transcribed here
textos.En la app, aquí se abre la carpeta: In the app, the folder opens here
textos.En la vista previa la IA es de mentira:: In the preview the AI is pretend: in the app, your AI understands any request.
textos.Puse un zoom cuando dices «ahorrar una h: I added a zoom when you say “save an hour”.
textos.Agregué el título «Edita en 1 minuto» al: I added the title “Edit in 1 minute” at the start.
textos.Cambié los subtítulos a una palabra a la: I switched the captions to one word at a time.
I made it square (1:1) for Instagram.
textos.Corté «Mmm… te muestro cómo», que sobrab: I cut “Hmm… let me show you how”, which wasn't needed.
textos.Ahorra una hora editando tus videos: Save an hour editing your videos
textos.Dos pasos y tu Short está listo: Two steps and your Short is ready
textos.Abre con una pregunta y una promesa conc: Opens with a question and a concrete promise.
textos.Pasos cortos y claros, ideal para guarda: Short, clear steps, great for saving.
While you're not talking. It lowers itself when you speak.
textos.Elige una canción de tu computador. Suen: Choose a song from your computer. It plays under your voice and lowers itself when you speak, so what you say is always clear.
textos.MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG o FLAC. Si es más cor: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or FLAC. If it's shorter than the video, it loops.
Loops if it's shorter than the video.
textos.Sin transcripción, la vista previa no ba: Without a transcript, the preview doesn't lower the music while you talk. The export does.
textos.Esta música está fuera de la carpeta del: This music is outside the project folder: it won't play in the preview, but it will in the export. Choose it again to bring it into the folder.
textos.Usa solo música tuya o libre: Only use your own or free music
textos.Las canciones conocidas tienen derechos: Well-known songs are copyrighted: YouTube, Instagram and TikTok may mute your video, block it or take away its earnings. Use music you made, music with a license that allows it in videos, or royalty-free music. If the license asks you to credit the author, add it to the description.
textos.En la vista previa suena una música de p: The preview plays a test track made by Corta
textos.Arrastra los bordes de un tramo para aju: Drag the edges of a segment to adjust it. With the keyboard, use the arrow keys.
textos.Elige el video que quieres editar: Choose the video you want to edit
Choose an MP4, MOV or WebM video.
textos.En la vista previa no hay nada que actua: There's nothing to update in the preview.
textos.Espera a que termine de transcribir o ex: Wait until it finishes transcribing or exporting and try again.
textos.Espera a que termine lo que está haciend: Wait until this video finishes what it's doing.
